{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float (cleaning step, not relevant to age but needed for integrity)
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for all customers who converted (converted == 1), regardless of status or revenue
# This includes QA orders and refunded orders, as per the contract
converted_all = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Now, exclude only rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data sentinel)
converted_valid_age = converted_all[converted_all['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Total converted customers (including QA/refunded): {len(converted_all)}")
print(f"Converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_valid_age)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}")"}
